title: Count distinct substrings
statement:
Count how many different non-empty substrings a string has. A substring is a contiguous run of characters; two substrings are the same when they hold the same characters, wherever they occur. For example "aba" has the substrings a, b, ab, ba and aba: 5 different ones ("a" occurs twice but counts once).

Input: one line holding a string s of lowercase letters (1 <= length of s <= 100000).

Output: one line with the number of distinct non-empty substrings of s. The answer can exceed 2^31, so use a 64-bit integer. Listing all O(n^2) substrings is far too slow for the largest tests; you need about O(n log n) or better (suffix array with LCP, or suffix automaton).

Example
Input:
ababa
Output:
9
(a, b, ab, ba, aba, bab, abab, baba, ababa)
